cases.input:
Dev asked you something
I looked at the backup options for the Mac mini. Backblaze B2 costs about $1 a month and restic supports it; S3 is about $3 and needs a lifecycle rule. Should I use B2 or S3?

Run the suite
Blocked: Which simulator should I use? The suite needs iOS 26, but the only booted one is on iOS 18.6. I can boot the iPhone 17 Pro or create a new one.

Web Dev asked you something
The plan card needs a new endpoint. Do you want it in this PR or a separate one after the task comments land?

Tablebook Dev asked you something
The booking page loads 3 MB of images on mobile. I can lazy-load them now, or wait for the redesign next week. Which do you prefer?

Approve: Renew the domain
I'm ready to renew loft.dev for one year at $12. It expires in 5 days. Shall I go ahead?

Fix the build
Failed: Xcode 27 is missing on the Mac mini, so the iOS 27 targets can't build. Install it, or I keep building against iOS 26.

Vaultly Marketing asked you something
Two headlines for the launch post: "Passwords that just work" or "One vault for the whole team". Which one?

Security asked you something
Finding 47: the QA environment uses the production Firebase project. I can switch it to the QA project now, but QA testers will lose their test accounts. OK to switch?

QA Agent asked you something
Mobile QA can't reach your iPhone; it shows offline. Can you unlock it and connect it by cable, or should I test only in the Simulator for now?

Orchestrator asked you something
Web Dev and iOS Dev both want to change the chat's message format. Should they agree on it first, or should backend go first?

Ledgerly Dev asked you something
The currency rounding differs between the report and the export. Should both round half up, or keep banker's rounding in the export?

Measure sizes
Done: the Mac mini has 15 GB free after cleanup. Do you want me to schedule this cleanup weekly?

Web Dev asked you something
Push needs an APNs key from your Apple Developer account. Can you create one, or should I write the steps down for you?

Tablebook QA asked you something
The new onboarding passes on iPhone but fails on Android at step 3. Should I file it for Tablebook Dev or try a fix myself?

Backend Agent asked você algo
Olhei as opções de backup do Mac mini. O Backblaze B2 custa cerca de 1 dólar por mês e o restic suporta; o S3 custa 3 dólares. Uso o B2 ou o S3?

Rodar a suíte
Bloqueado: qual simulador eu uso? A suíte precisa do iOS 26, mas o único ligado está no iOS 18.6. Posso ligar o iPhone 17 Pro ou criar um novo.

Tablebook Dev perguntou algo
A página de reservas carrega 3 MB de imagens no celular. Faço o carregamento sob demanda agora ou espero o redesign da semana que vem?

Aprovar: renovar o domínio
Estou pronto para renovar o loft.dev por um ano por 12 dólares. Ele vence em 5 dias. Posso seguir?

Corrigir o build
Falhou: o Xcode 27 não está instalado no Mac mini, então os alvos do iOS 27 não compilam. Instale ou eu continuo com o iOS 26.

Security perguntou algo
Achado 47: o ambiente de QA usa o projeto Firebase de produção. Posso trocar agora, mas os testadores perdem as contas de teste. Posso trocar?

Orchestrator perguntou algo
O Web Dev e o iOS Dev querem mudar o formato das mensagens. Eles combinam antes, ou o backend vai primeiro?

Vaultly Marketing perguntou algo
Dois títulos para o post: "Senhas que funcionam" ou "Um cofre para o time todo". Qual?

Medir tamanhos
Pronto: o Mac mini tem 15 GB livres depois da limpeza. Quer que eu agende essa limpeza toda semana?

QA Agent perguntou algo
O Mobile QA não alcança seu iPhone; ele aparece offline. Você pode desbloquear e ligar no cabo, ou testo só no simulador por enquanto?
